newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ansett boosts Air NZ by NZ$16.7 mln in Dec qtr.
newsitem.headline: Ansett boosts Air NZ by NZ$16.7 mln in Dec qtr.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd said on Wednesday that Ansett Australia contributed NZ$16.7 million profit to Air New Zealand's earnings from associates for the three months to December 1996.

But like other Australasian-based carriers, Ansett International's operations encountered adverse trading conditions during the half year, reflecting continuing aggressive market competition, the appreciation of the Australian dollar against the Japanese yen and high jet fuel prices.
"These difficult trading conditions resulted in a higher than expected loss on international operations for the half year," Air NZ said.
Ansett International had also incurred start-up costs when it commenced operations to Seoul from July 1996.
Air NZ earlier reported a sharp decline in net profit for the six months to December of NZ$76.74 million, down 43.2 percent on the same comparative period a year earlier.
It also said that the full year result would be materially below the previous year's of NZ$225.2 million.
The second half outcome would also fall short of the first half, Air NZ said.
